description: This file contains two SCSS mixins: 'visually-hidden' and 'visually-hidden-focusable', used for visually hiding content while keeping it accessible for assistive technologies. It includes comments with links to accessibility resources and explanations.

methods.name: visually-hidden
methods.description: A mixin that styles content to be visually hidden but still accessible for assistive technologies.

methods.name: visually-hidden-focusable
methods.description: A mixin that makes content visible only when focused or when any child is focused, based on the 'visually-hidden' mixin.
